purpose: Select the OTP email produced by a specific Oracle Recruiting Cloud login request without depending on one sender or one exact subject.

inputs.tenantKey: derived from the first tenant host label, for example egup
inputs.companyDomains: optional allowlist learned from job metadata

concurrency.rule: Do not issue two simultaneous OTP requests for the same candidate and Oracle tenant because their messages may be indistinguishable.

hardReject: receivedTime is more than maximumMessageAgeBeforeRequestMs before requestedAtEpochMs
message body does not contain exactly one plausible six-digit code near OTP or verification language
messageId was already consumed by this application attempt

scoring.signal: recipient exactly matches candidateEmail after HTML decoding and normalization
receivedTime is at or after requestedAtEpochMs
body contains OTP or identity-verification wording near a six-digit number
sender belongs to a known Oracle family
sender domain is in the job company's configured allowlist
HTML or text body contains an HTTPS URL whose host exactly matches tenantHost
sender local part or body contains tenantKey as a distinct token

selection.ambiguityPolicy: If the two highest candidates are within 10 points and contain different codes, keep polling briefly and then fail safely rather than guessing.

codeExtraction.preferredPattern: verification wording followed within 120 characters by a standalone six-digit number
codeExtraction.fallbackPattern: a single standalone six-digit number in the normalized text body
